name: expiry_day_premium_decay_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY weekly expiry Thursdays, option market makers who have sold near-ATM calls and puts are net short gamma across thousands of crore in notional. As NIFTY deviates from session VWAP — which on expiry days closely tracks the aggregate gamma-neutral pin level — dealers must delta-hedge directionally, amplifying the move beyond what fundamental order flow would justify. Once VIX begins declining from the session open (typically 45-90 minutes after open), gamma exposure has partially decayed and dealer hedge ratios stabilize; at that point, the accumulated overshoot unwinds rapidly over 30-120 seconds as dealers lighten delta hedges. On NIFTY, this produces measurable 15-30 spot point VWAP reversions that begin predictably when a confirmed VIX decline signals gamma pressure is easing and the z-score of deviation from VWAP starts recovering direction.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP from 09:15, reset each day. On expiry days this serves as the gamma pin reference level — market makers' aggregate delta hedge is near-neutral at VWAP, so overshoots above/below are the deviation we're fading. Cumulative measure; no scaling needed.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Z-score of NIFTY deviation from VWAP using a 20-minute (240-bar) rolling std. NOT 60×12=720 bars (60 min). We use 20 min because: (1) pre-10am volatility from gap opens is structurally different from mid-morning trading and would inflate the std estimate, making post-10am deviations look smaller than they are; (2) 240 bars gives enough observations for a stable estimate while reflecting only the current intraday vol regime. We fire at z < -1.5 or z > 1.5 — the typical expiry gamma overshoot produces z-scores of 1.5-3.0.

indicators.name: zscore_delta_12
indicators.purpose: Rate of change of z-score over 60 seconds (12 × 5s bars). Used to confirm the reversal has started — not just a pause but an active recovery of the z-score toward 0. 12-bar window (60s) chosen because: 5s noise produces frequent false z-score ticks that a 6-bar (30s) delta would catch as reversals; 60s gives enough directional confirmation while still entering early in the reversion.

indicators.name: vix_change_from_open
indicators.purpose: VIX level relative to the day's opening VIX, capturing whether gamma pressure is easing (negative = declining VIX) or still building (positive). Declining VIX on expiry day is the primary filter: it signals dealers have reduced their net short gamma exposure and are no longer forced to chase delta hedges, making the overshoot reversion viable.

conditions: is_thursday == True — only fire on weekly/monthly NIFTY expiry Thursdays
time_minutes in [600, 840) — 10:00-14:00 IST, post-first-hour gamma chaos window
vwap_zscore < -1.5 — NIFTY has overshot 1.5+ std below session VWAP due to gamma-forced selling
zscore_delta_12 > 0.10 — z-score is actively recovering toward 0 (reversal confirmed over 60s)
vix_change_from_open < 0 — VIX declining from open, gamma pressure easing
buy_ce.confirmation: fire on same bar close — 5s resolution lets us enter as the reversion begins

conditions: vwap_zscore > 1.5 — NIFTY has overshot 1.5+ std above session VWAP

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts (~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). Expiry-day gamma overshoots on NIFTY typically extend 15-30 spot pts from VWAP; if NIFTY moves a further 10 spot pts against us after entry, the mean reversion thesis is broken — the move has extended into continuation territory beyond typical gamma overshoot exhaustion. At a 2-min NIFTY typical move of 5-10 option pts, this stop triggers only on clear adverse continuation.
exit.target_rationale: 9 option pts (~18 NIFTY spot pts). Expiry-day VWAP reversions on NIFTY cover 18-25 spot pts in the first leg within 60-120 seconds once gamma hedge unwinding begins. At delta ~0.5, 18 spot pts = 9 option pts. This captures the first leg at 1:1.8 R:R. Deliberately not targeting the full reversion to 0-z-score (which would be 15-20+ option pts) because second-leg reversions are slower and face mean reversion exhaustion.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:00 IST — expiry day last hour (14:00-15:30) has chaotic pinning dynamics that invalidate the reversion thesis

filters.vix_filter: vix_change_from_open < 0 — only trade when VIX is declining from open (gamma easing); if VIX is still rising, hedging pressure has not peaked and the overshoot may extend further
filters.time_filter: 10:00-14:00 IST only; first 45 min (09:15-10:00) is the chaotic gamma-amplified push window, not the reversion window
filters.volume_filter: implicit via VWAP computation — zero-volume bars contribute zero to VWAP deviation
filters.trend_filter: VWAP z-score reversal confirmation via zscore_delta_12 threshold
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices
filters.event_filter: Thursday only (is_thursday check) — strategy fires only on expiry Thursdays (~52 days/year)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — expiry day gamma mechanics are structural to NSE F&O market design; weekly expiries entrench this effect further as more participants trade short-dated options

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-15 Nifty50 constituent stocks on expiry Thursdays at 1-min bars, holding 30-90 minutes. Changes: (1) universe collapsed from stock basket to NIFTY index directly — the gamma exposure that drives individual stock overshoots is even larger at the index level (aggregate option OI on NIFTY far exceeds any single constituent); (2) hold time compressed from 30-90 min to 30-180 seconds — at 5s resolution we enter as the reversion begins rather than waiting for full 1-min bar confirmation; (3) lookback for zscore std window compressed from 60 min (original 60-bar 1min) to 20 min (240 bars at 5s) to avoid inflating the denominator with pre-10am volatile bars; (4) added zscore_delta_12 reversal confirmation — not present in original because 1-min bars already implicitly required multi-5s confirmation; (5) time window slightly extended to 14:00 (original was 14:00 too) but we explicitly exclude 14:00-15:30 which is option pinning chaos; (6) trailing stop and breakeven rules from original dropped per pipeline design.
weaknesses: Only fires on Thursdays (~52 days/year) — extremely low frequency; 3 trades/day maximum means ~156 trades/year, backtest will be limited
Weekly vs monthly expiry produce different gamma profiles — monthly expiry last Thursdays have stronger pinning (much larger open interest) but same code treats both identically
If Thursday coincides with RBI policy, budget, or global risk-off event, the directional flow overwhelms gamma hedging and VWAP overshoots continue rather than revert
NIFTY 5s volume data is noisier than 1-min data; VWAP computed on 5s bars may show spurious deviations from zero-volume bars in less liquid periods
